title: Community
for: forums, member communities, community chat servers

manual.export: Export members, topics or posts as CSV from the community admin panel (Discourse: Admin > Data Explorer; Circle: Members > Export).

vendors.name: Discourse

read_only_switch.name: --allow_writes
read_only_switch.value: absent (writes are off unless the flag is passed)

caveats: Writes are off by default; `--allow_writes` registers post, topic, message, category and user mutation tools. Do not add the flag to a committed entry.
Authentication goes through a JSON profile file kept outside the repo (`--profile`), never on the command line; public forums need none.
Requires Node 24 or newer. Pinned to @discourse/mcp 0.3.1 (npm, checked 2026-09-04).

auth.where: DISCOURSE_MCP_PROFILE is the path to a JSON profile holding auth_pairs (Discourse: Admin > API > New key); DISCOURSE_SITE_URL is the forum URL

vendors.name: Circle
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__circle`) until checked
Endpoint seen in secondary listings only; confirm on Circle's developer docs before wiring.

vendors.name: Discord
caveats: No official server as of 2026-09-04. Community servers SaseQ/discord-mcp and hanweg/mcp-discord run with a bot token and can post; community server maintained by SaseQ / hanweg; judge as a script, not a vendor tool.
A bot token in a community server's environment is a full write credential; prefer a read-scoped script or a generic connector.

vendors.name: Slack (community workspace)
capabilities: community channels, threads and search through the chat category's Slack server
caveats: wire Slack under chat; the same server serves community channels
This repo already posts to Slack through its own bot (scripts/slack_post.py); a community workspace is a second workspace, so it needs its own token or OAuth grant.
